content.meta_description: Sigoise extra virgin olive oil, cold-extracted in Tlemcen. 250 ml to 5 L, delivered to all 58 wilayas, cash on delivery.

hero.lede: Sigoise from the Oued Lakhdar hillsides, cold-pressed within hours of picking. The same lot that leaves for export.

catalog.title: The shop
catalog.lede: One oil, five formats. The contents are identical: only the container changes.
catalog.note: Prices include tax and exclude delivery.

delivery.title: Delivery and payment
delivery.lede: We deliver to all 58 wilayas. You pay the courier in cash on arrival — nothing up front.
delivery.pickup_body: You can collect your order at the mill on national road N7. It costs nothing, and you see where the oil comes from.
delivery.note: Exact lead time and charges are confirmed by phone before dispatch.

gallery.title: The mill
gallery.body_1: We show the room as it is, unstaged. A buyer committing to a container has a right to see where the oil is made, and a well-kept room reads more convincingly in an ordinary photograph than in a studio shot.
gallery.body_2: Oil at the decanter outlet, before filtering: that dense, cloudy green is what an olive pressed on the day it was picked gives.
gallery.shot_alt: A stream of green oil running from a stainless spout into a settling vessel

process.title: From tree to tank
process.lede: Six operations, in order. Each one carries a time or temperature constraint, and that is where the quality of a lot is decided.
process.mark_alt: TLEMCENYA seal, extra virgin olive oil, heritage of Tlemcen
process.step_1_body: Pneumatic combs and ground nets. Fruit travels in ventilated 22 kg crates, never in sacks — a sack crushes the olive and raises acidity before it reaches the mill.
process.step_2_body: Weighing, de-leafing, cold-water washing. Every delivery is assigned a lot number that follows the oil all the way to the container.
process.step_3_body: Stainless hammer mill, continuous flow. The paste is formed with as little air contact as the line allows.
process.step_4_body: Forty minutes under nitrogen, 26 °C maximum. Run it warmer and you gain yield and lose aroma; we decide for aroma.
process.step_5_body: Two-phase centrifugal decanter. No added water, so no polyphenols washed out and no olive mill wastewater to treat.
process.step_6_body: Nitrogen-blanketed 12,000 l stainless tanks at 16 °C, in the dark. Packing happens against an order, never in advance.

location.title: Find us
location.lede: The mill is in Tlemcen, in western Algeria. The usual port of loading is Ghazaouet, with Oran as the alternative.
location.note: Mill visits and buyer audits: ask through the quotation form and we will arrange the appointment.
